statement.zh: Li Feng 2006《早期中国的景观与权力》讨论西周政治地理与西周灭亡危机。
statement.en: Li Feng 2006 Landscape and Power in Early China analyzes Western Zhou political geography and the dynasty’s crisis/fall.
